//: TODO(design): first batch of dialogues, written by Claude for M5 (GAME_DESIGN.md §1, §11, §14); change them freely. trigger: when the dialogue can come up: afterBattle, newBiome (first step into a biome), enemyAhead (an encounter is about to start), restInLair (end of a turn in the lair: Old Mother Toad), serpentOnTheWay (end of a turn away from the lair, now and then), serpentInBattle (one short line over the battle, only the first line is used), eventOnly (only when an event's choice asks for it by id), newGeneration (a new generation hatches: Old Mother Toad greets the heiress), ancestorInSleep (now and then when a new generation hatches, lineage.json ancestorVoice). Of the dialogues that fit, the one with the highest priority comes up (ties: random). once: said at most once per lineage (default true): an heiress doesn't hear again what her mothers heard, a new lineage does. conditions (all must hold; leave one out to not care): rings, biomes (where the hydra stands, or the new biome), flags, notFlags, minAlert, maxAlert, minTurn, headClasses, minHeads, maxHeads, won, severedAtLeast, grownAtLeast, cauterizedAtLeast (in the battle just fought, or heads grown at rest), newEnemyTypes (met for the first time), minGeneration, maxGeneration (the hydra's generation, 1 = the first of her lineage), mutations (she carries all of these, mutations.json), inheritedAtLeast and motherKilledBy (a new generation: mutations inherited, enemy types that killed her mother). Every flag must be listed in flags.json. speaker: toad, serpent, ancestor (the hydra's mother, through her sleep: no portrait), head:any (any head), head:other (a different head), head:new (a head that just grew), head:<class id> (a head of that class, e.g. head:biter). If the heads can't be found, the dialogue is skipped. In a text {any}, {other}, {new} are those heads' names, {biome} the biome's name, {name} the hydra's name, {lineage} her lineage's, {mother} her mother's and {mutation} one of the mutations she inherited (or carries). setFlags: flags set when said; a choice can set its own and has a reply.

serpentVoice.//: How often the Serpent speaks on the way: at most once every minTurnsBetween turns, then with chancePerTurn at the end of each turn. battleChance: chance of a short line at the start of a battle.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: I bit him. You're welcome.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: You bit him after I had dissolved most of him.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: Most of him is not him.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: That is exactly what most of him is.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: They burned the stump. They brought a torch to a neck.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: It's only a scar. It heals if we rest in the lair.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: It is not about healing. It is about manners.

lines.speaker: head:new
lines.text: Where are we?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Underground. Fighting the Order. Try to keep up.

lines.speaker: head:new
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Ask the one who used to be there. Oh. Right.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: We lost one and got two. I am trying to feel bad about it.

lines.speaker: head:new
lines.text: Hello! I'm one of the two.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: It's getting easier.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: Was there... a fight? I was... composing.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: You breathed on a man until he fell over.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: Then it was... a poem.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: Fourteen plates of armour so far this run. I have been keeping count.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Nobody asked.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: Science does not wait to be asked.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: The Order tastes of candle wax and paperwork.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: That is the paperwork. They keep it inside their armour.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: In case they are eaten. So the Order knows who was.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: They keep coming. Have they no other swamps to burn?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I think we are the only swamp. I think that is the problem.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: Water above... water below... I feel... understood.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: I feel wet.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: The roots are moving.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Roots do not move.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Then they are being very still at us.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: Human graves. They bury their dead in rows, with the names written on.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: Labelled. Like a larder.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: That is not the point.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: It is a little bit the point.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Salt. Everything here wants to dry us out.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: I will not... be cured... like a ham.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Strange. Just now, we all agreed on something.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I agreed first.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: And it's gone.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: {biome}. Nobody told us about {biome}.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Nobody tells us anything. We are a hydra.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: Men in tin. My favourite.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: That is steel, not tin. It dissolves just the same. Slower. With more screaming.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That one has an axe and is looking at our necks.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Which necks?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: All of them. He is making a list.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Fire. Why is it always fire?

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: They are the Order of the Eternal Flame. It is in the name.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: I will put it out... gently... like a candle... like a man.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That one is pointing a plank at us.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: A crossbow. He does not have to come close.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That is cheating. Somebody tell him that is cheating.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: There is a man with a book. He is counting our Muck.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Out loud. With a quill.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: If he gets away, a tenth of everything goes with him. Do not let him get away.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That one is shiny all over.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: A Knight of the Eternal Flame. They charge, and they are afraid of nothing.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Not even of us?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: He has been told about us. He came anyway.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: They are carrying a man in a chair.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: The Master of the Order. He has come to burn us personally.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Personally. That is almost flattering.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Eat him, child. What he carries will be yours.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: More of them. They have started sending the ones who volunteer.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: The ones who volunteer are the worst. They have read about us.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Back in the swamp. Good. Lie still while I count your heads.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: I have buried eleven of you. You are not my favourite.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Which one was your favourite?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: The quiet one. It died.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Where did you find that.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: It's theirs. The Hushed. I've only ever seen drawings of these.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Is it valuable?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: It's a face that never needed a mouth. Put it somewhere I can't see it.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: You've been hearing things. Don't look at each other, I can tell.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: It's him. The Serpent. He talks in his sleep, and you lot are the only ones near enough to hear.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Why doesn't he talk to you?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: He used to.

reply.speaker: toad
reply.text: Hm. He always did like a riddle. He never cared much for the answers.

reply.speaker: toad
reply.text: Keep it, then. It's yours now. It used to be mine.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Something turned over in its sleep today. I felt it in my knees.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Whatever you did, do it carefully. Or not at all. Mostly not at all.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Two new heads where the scar was. Let me look at you.

lines.speaker: head:new
lines.text: Hello. Are you our mother?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Nobody is your mother, dear. I'm just old.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Those carvings you saw. The Hushed made them.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Who were the Hushed?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Very quiet people. That is most of what anyone knows about them.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: They kept his song in tune. Then they stopped. Nobody heard them leave. That was rather the point of them.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: That skull you found. I knew her.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Was she your favourite?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: No. But she was close.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: So you've met one of the Discordant. They hear him too. Bits of him. Bits are worse than nothing.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Are we Discordant?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Surveyed, are we? Officially?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: In red wax.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Then you're safe. Right up until someone reads it.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: You smell of the Deeps. Don't eat the glowing ones. Don't listen to them either.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: The Mycelium talks to everything at once. Not everything it talks to comes back.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: The Order is talking about you up in the castle. I can smell their candles from here.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: They have a form for a swamp like ours. It has a box marked 'burned'.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Sleep, all of you. One at a time is fine. You never manage it together.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: ...coiled... around the warm heart... still coiled... still...

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: Did someone say heart? Is there food?

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: It was... a lullaby.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: It was a voice inside my head, which is a medical concern.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Who keeps the time now? The drum is cold. The hands are gone.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: What drum?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: What hands? None of us has hands.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Many mouths. One throat. Remember the throat.

lines.speaker: head:biter
lines.text: He means we should eat more.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: He means we share a body and ought to act like it.

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: He means... throat.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Little fires on the skin of the world. They itch.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: The Order. He means the Order.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Or a rash. Sometimes a rash is just a rash.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: They sang me to sleep, and then they stopped singing. Why did they stop?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Who stopped?

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: ...hush...

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I think that was the answer.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Not yet. Do not wake me yet. Some who call my name want me awake.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Someone wants him awake?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I want me awake. It rarely works.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: ...too many songs here... the small white roots sing them all at once...

lines.speaker: head:mistBreather
lines.text: Shh... I can hear... the colours.

lines.speaker: head:acidSpitter
lines.text: You can hear the spores. Breathe less.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Closer. Warmer. Do you feel the coil turn?

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: I feel something turn. I think it's the floor.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Bite... the little fires...

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Many mouths... one throat...

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: The fire is small. You are not.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: Hold... hold the song...

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: ...who is there... who keeps the time... is it morning...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: It's never morning down here.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Don't tell him that. Let him sleep.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: You heard it. Now you know what was lost. Keep it, little many-mouths. Keep it in tune.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Keep what?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I think we're supposed to hum.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Together?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: That does seem to be the hard part.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: It's opening.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Doors do that. It is the whole idea of them.

lines.speaker: serpent
lines.text: ...a door of theirs... they opened for the song, once... mind the quiet on the other side, little many-mouths... the quiet bites...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Did he say the quiet bites?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: He says a lot of things.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: You opened one of their doors.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: It wanted to be opened.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Doors of the Hushed want to stay shut. Remember that, the next time one agrees with you.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: They're eating the rock.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: They're eating the heat in the rock. The rock is just in the way.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Where are they going?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Somewhere warmer. Everyone is.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: You smell of hot stone. You've met the Cinderkin.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: They melted us a tunnel.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: They melted themselves a tunnel. You happened to be standing at one end of it.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Their hives are cathedrals of cold lava, somewhere below. Nobody who has gone to look has come back warm.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: So. {mother} is dead, and here you are. You have her eyes. Several of them.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Who is {mother}?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Your mother. Try not to make a habit of this.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Of what?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Either.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Men-at-arms killed {mother}. They will want the forms signed by her next of kin.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That's us.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Then sign nothing, {name}. Bite whoever brings the pen.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: A headhunter took {mother}, one head at a time. He is paid by the head.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: How many did she have?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Enough to make him comfortable. Grow more than she did. It is the only revenge that pays.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: {mother} was burnt shut by a lay brother with a torch. Neck by neck. He was very thorough.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Is that why everything smells of smoke?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Everything smells of smoke because the Order exists. Mind the torches, {name}.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: I have buried a good many of you, {name}. You are not my favourite.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Who is?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: The first one. She knew when to keep her mouths shut.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: You carry {mother}'s mark: {mutation}.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Is that good?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: It was not good enough for her. Make better use of it.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Up you get, {name} of the Line of {lineage}. The swamp won't defend itself, and neither will I.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: {name}. Eat something. You still look like an egg.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: We were an egg this morning.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: It shows.

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: Another hydra. The Order will be thrilled.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Will they?

lines.speaker: toad
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Something of {mother}'s came down to us: {mutation}.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: I wanted her teeth.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Everybody wanted her teeth.

lines.speaker: ancestor
lines.text: ...the torches... count the torches before you bite, {name}... I never counted...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Did anyone else hear that?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: No. Go back to sleep.

lines.speaker: ancestor
lines.text: ...he gave me a receipt... keep it safe... they will ask for it...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Keep what?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: It's a dream. Don't keep anything.

lines.speaker: ancestor
lines.text: ...my heads are on his pole... they are still arguing...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: That sounds like us.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: That sounds like us, for ever.

lines.speaker: ancestor
lines.text: ...go deeper, {name}... I never went deep enough... down there the Serpent sleeps lighter...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Was that Mother?

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: Mother is dead.

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Then she is very persistent.

lines.speaker: ancestor
lines.text: ...eat well... sleep in the mud... trust nothing that is on fire...

lines.speaker: head:any
lines.text: Good advice.

lines.speaker: head:other
lines.text: From someone who's dead.
